title: Nvidia Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard
summary:
NVIDIA announced two new offerings to improve AI agent performance and efficiency:

**Nemotron 3.5 Lightning** is a 30-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts (MoE) open model designed for high-volume, specialized agentic tasks. It delivers up to 4x faster output speed and 30% faster agentic task completion compared with similar models. It can be post-trained with NVIDIA NeMo on domain-specific data and runs across PCs, workstations, data centers, and the cloud. The model is already being customized by companies like CrowdStrike, Harvey, CodeRabbit, Lila Sciences, and Fastino Labs.

**NeMo Switchyard** is an open source model routing library for AI agents. It automatically routes prompts to the most capable and efficient model for each task, based on quality, latency, or cost priorities. NVIDIA benchmarks show it maintains frontier-level accuracy while reducing task completion costs to nearly one-third of using Opus 4.8 alone. Partners including Boomi, Cadence, Cognition, LangChain, LiteLLM, Ramp, Siemens, and others are integrating or evaluating Switchyard to cut costs and improve efficiency.

Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is available on Hugging Face, ModelScope, OpenRouter, and build.nvidia.com as a NIM microservice, with ecosystem support from cloud partners. NeMo Switchyard is available on GitHub and coming to partner platforms. Together, they give enterprises greater control over deployment, routing, and efficiency in agentic AI systems.

title: Mojo 1.0
summary:
Mojo 1.0 has officially been released, marking a major milestone for the language. The update provides a stable, production-ready foundation for long-term development, with changes now primarily additive. Mojo is already used in production for Modular’s commercial infrastructure.

The 26.5 release includes final cleanups and simplifications: variables are now consistently declared with `var`, closures unified, and a single Pointer type. New features include Python-style lambda syntax, a more stable LSP server, improved memory safety diagnostics (e.g., reference invalidation), and more consistent `where` clauses with descriptive messages. The Mojo AI skills are "1.0 ready." The Mojo compiler and toolchain remain on track to be open-sourced in 2026.

Future plans focus on making Mojo a general-purpose systems language, with asynchronous programming, pattern matching, and unions on the roadmap.

MAX also gets updates: simpler installation options (`max["serve"]`, `max["benchmark"]`, `max["all"]`) and support for two new model families—GLM-5.2 and Nemotron-H, both hybrid Mamba-2 models. Kimi 2.5 works with Module V3, and the open-source agent skills collection has seen strong adoption.

Users can get started with `uv pip install --upgrade mojo` or `max[all]`. ModCon takes place August 18 in San Francisco with a livestream option. The article emphasizes that 1.0 is just the beginning and thanks the community of nearly 200 contributors and thousands who filed issues and shaped the language.

title: Compression Is Prediction
summary:
The article argues that compression and prediction are fundamentally the same task. In information theory, a good model assigns high probability to data it has not seen, and that predictive ability can be turned directly into compression: fewer bits are needed to encode data the model can anticipate. Conversely, any effective compressor must implicitly predict upcoming patterns. So training a model to minimize prediction error is equivalent to teaching it to compress data.

The article applies this idea to large language models. LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, which means they learn the statistical structure of text. Their cross-entropy loss is a measure of code length: lower loss means the model can encode the same text in fewer bits. This explains why LLMs can act as strong lossless compressors of text and why compression performance can be used as a measure of understanding.

It also connects the concept to practical model compression. After training, models can be made smaller through techniques like quantization, which reduces the precision of weights to shrink memory and compute requirements. This works because much of the fine-grained numerical detail in a model is redundant; enough predictive power remains even with lower precision. In this light, quantization is lossy compression applied to a system that was itself built through compression-by-prediction.

Overall, the article highlights the deep link between information theory, machine learning, and model deployment, showing that seeing models as predictors-and-compressors can guide better design, evaluation, and efficiency.
chinese_title: 压缩即预测
chinese_summary:
文章认为，压缩和预测本质上是同一任务。在信息论中，一个良好的模型会对未见过的数据赋予高概率，而这种预测能力可以直接转化为压缩：对于模型能预测的数据，所需的编码比特数更少。反过来，任何有效的压缩器都必须隐式地预测接下来的模式。因此，以最小化预测误差为目标训练模型，等同于教它压缩数据。

文章将这一思想应用于大型语言模型。大型语言模型通过下一个词元预测进行训练，这意味着它们学习了文本的统计结构。它们的交叉熵损失是编码长度的一种度量：损失越低，意味着模型能用更少的比特编码同一文本。这解释了为什么大型语言模型能够充当强大的文本无损压缩器，也解释了为什么压缩性能可以用作理解程度的衡量标准。

文章还将这一概念与实际模型压缩联系起来。训练结束后，可以通过量化等技术来缩小模型，量化会降低权重的精度，从而减少内存和计算需求。这种方法之所以有效，是因为模型中许多细粒度的数值细节是冗余的；即使精度降低，仍能保留足够的预测能力。从这个角度来看，量化是对一个本身通过预测式压缩构建的系统进行有损压缩。

总体而言，文章强调了信息论、机器学习和模型部署之间的深层联系，表明将模型视为预测器和压缩器可以指导更好的设计、评估和效率提升。

title: How we used to get jobs: A newspaper classifieds story
summary:
David recounts how he landed his dream job in 2000 as Polo Ralph Lauren’s in-house photographer through a newspaper classified ad—specifically in the New York Times. He had long told this story but decided to verify it using his digital archives, which include emails since 1997 and scanned documents. After finding the cover letter he submitted, he searched the Times Machine archive and located the listing: a “Leading Fashion Company” seeking a staff photographer with 4x5 camera proficiency, with instructions to fax a resume to “CWP” (his future boss).

While confirming the ad, he questions two memories: first, whether he really identified the company by looking up the phone number in the early days of Google; second, whether his future boss really left a voicemail saying she had gone through “a butt load of resumes.” He can’t verify the latter because his answering machine tapes were never digitized.

He shares this story as a relic of pre-internet job hunting and invites readers to share their own classifieds experiences—whether for jobs, dates, couches, or anything else. The piece reflects on nostalgia, the reliability of memory, and how even a job found in a physical newspaper can become part of personal history.
chinese_title: 我们过去如何找工作：报纸分类广告的故事

在确认广告的同时，他对两段记忆提出了质疑：第一，他是否真的在谷歌早期通过查询电话号码识别出了这家公司；第二，他未来的老板是否真的留过语音留言，说她已经翻看了“一大堆简历”。他无法核实后者，因为他的答录机磁带从未被数字化。

他分享这个故事，将其作为互联网时代之前求职的遗物，并邀请读者分享他们自己的分类广告经历——无论是找工作、约会、找沙发还是其他任何事。这篇文章反思了怀旧情怀、记忆的可靠性，以及即使在实体报纸上找到的一份工作，也能成为个人历史的一部分。

title: Making holograms with a pen plotter
summary:
The article describes using a pen plotter to create hand-etched holograms. The author begins by explaining the key optical insight: smudges and reflective ridges create highlights that change position as the viewer moves, with the speed of movement inversely proportional to the ridge’s radius of curvature. This allows drawn ridges to simulate realistic depth, making the effect genuinely holographic in the sense that even small cutouts retain the full scene.

To produce the holograms, the author “renders” a 3D scene by turning each point into a reflective ridge whose curvature encodes distance. A brief, optional math formula is included, but the main approach is intuitive and practical. Early attempts failed: flexible lamination sheets moved and warped, and waxed paper tore under the required volume of curves. The material that worked was old CD jewel cases, bought cheaply in bulk. A sharp pick from a Harbor Freight tool set proved ideal for etching.

Key lessons learned: the light source must be a point source for depth to be communicated clearly; a flashlight aimed so the glare sits just above the etches works best; more etches improve the result but can degrade the surface into a matte blob. The author considers trying a diamond-tipped stylus and asks readers if they have one to spare.

The piece is inspired by William Beaty’s work on hand-drawn holograms and highlights the idea that ancient civilizations could have made such images with simple tools. Overall, the author celebrates the magic of creating hologram-like art with a pen plotter, without expensive lasers or optical tables.
chinese_title: 用笔式绘图仪制作全息图
chinese_summary:
文章描述了使用笔式绘图仪制作手工蚀刻全息图的过程。作者首先解释了关键的光学原理：污迹和反射脊会产生高光，随着观看者移动，高光位置会改变，其移动速度与脊的曲率半径成反比。这使得绘制的脊能够模拟真实的深度，使效果真正具有全息性——即使是很小的裁剪部分也保留完整的场景。

为了制作全息图，作者通过将每个点变成反射脊来“渲染”3D场景，脊的曲率编码距离。文中包含一个简短的、可选的数学公式，但主要方法直观且实用。早期的尝试失败了：柔性覆膜片会移动和翘曲，蜡纸在所需的大量曲线下撕裂。有效的材料是旧CD盒，批量购买很便宜。Harbor Freight工具套装中的锋利尖头针被证明是蚀刻的理想工具。

关键经验教训：光源必须是点光源，才能清晰传达深度；手电筒的瞄准方式使眩光刚好位于蚀刻上方效果最佳；更多蚀刻能改善结果，但可能使表面退化为哑光斑块。作者考虑尝试金刚石尖笔，并询问读者是否有闲置的。

这篇文章的灵感来自威廉·比蒂关于手绘全息图的研究，并强调了古代文明可能用简单工具制作出此类图像的想法。总的来说，作者赞美了用笔式绘图仪创作类似全息艺术的神奇之处，无需昂贵的激光器或光学平台。

title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
summary:
The article demonstrates a method for decoding hidden “reasoning” traces from proprietary LLM APIs built by OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. The decoded reasoning closely matched the hidden thinking-token counts reported by the APIs, suggesting the technique reliably reconstructs internal chain-of-thought content.

The authors collected 6,708 publicly available agent trajectories from GitHub and Hugging Face that still contained encrypted reasoning blocks. After decoding, they recovered 315,320 reasoning blocks. Among genuine non-benchmark sessions, they found 704 distinct privacy artifacts, including:

- 62 API keys
- 33 passwords
- 24 access tokens
- 30 personal email addresses
- names, postal addresses, internal URLs, and other technical identifiers

Of these 704 artifacts, 64 appeared exclusively inside the reasoning blocks and were not visible anywhere in the session. The decoded examples include a Codex session where the model reasoned aloud about searching for and sanitizing API keys, GitHub tokens, Hugging Face tokens, and AWS credentials in a repository.

The paper also breaks down leaked items into categories: 351 technical identifiers, 204 PII, 126 credentials, and 23 other items. Overall, the research highlights a significant privacy risk: hidden LLM reasoning traces can contain sensitive information and be recovered despite encryption or intended secrecy.
chinese_title: 窃取专有LLM API中的推理轨迹
chinese_summary:
本文展示了一种从OpenAI、Anthropic和Google构建的专有LLM API中解码隐藏“推理”痕迹的方法。解码后的推理内容与API报告的隐藏思维令牌计数高度吻合，表明该技术能够可靠地重建内部思维链内容。

作者从GitHub和Hugging Face收集了6708条公开可用的智能体轨迹，这些轨迹仍包含加密的推理块。解码后，他们恢复了315320个推理块。在真实的非基准测试会话中，他们发现了704个不同的隐私痕迹，包括：

- 62个API密钥
- 33个密码
- 24个访问令牌
- 30个个人电子邮件地址
- 姓名、邮政地址、内部URL及其他技术标识符

在这704个痕迹中，有64个仅出现在推理块内部，在会话的任何其他地方均不可见。解码示例包括一个Codex会话，其中模型在推理过程中大声思考如何搜索并清理仓库中的API密钥、GitHub令牌、Hugging Face令牌和AWS凭证。

该论文还将泄露项目分类统计：351个技术标识符、204个个人身份信息、126个凭证和23个其他项目。总体而言，该研究揭示了一个重大的隐私风险：隐藏的LLM推理痕迹可能包含敏感信息，并且尽管经过加密或意图保密，仍可被恢复。

title: The whole of PyTorch on one page
summary:
# Summary: The Whole of PyTorch on One Page — Part 0: The Map

This opening article maps PyTorch's architecture across eight "floors" from Python to the chip, using measurable proofs run on an Apple M3 Max with torch 2.11.0.

**Key layers:** `torch._C` is a tiny 49 KB stub that loads the real framework: `libtorch_cpu.dylib` (206.5 MB) and `libtorch_python.dylib` (28.5 MB). The Python code users write is the smallest layer; the compiled body dominates.

**The boundary:** Every tensor operation crosses into C++, where the dispatcher routes calls through a stack of layers (autograd, mixed precision, etc.). A one-element add costs 0.54 microseconds — nearly pure dispatch machinery — limiting Python to ~1.9M ops/second.

**The kernel:** Three thousand six hundred seventy-seven operation names exist, each mapping to per-device, per-dtype kernel bodies. The dispatcher selects exactly one per call. The operation list grows from `native_functions.yaml` and `derivatives.yaml`.

**Two clocks:** On GPUs, Python requests work and returns immediately while the chip computes asynchronously. In the demo, 50 matmuls were queued in 1.58 ms but took 73.83 ms to finish. This split makes `loss.item()` expensive — it forces Python to wait for the entire queue.

**The turn:** `loss.backward()` works because the forward pass recorded an autograd graph: a chain of function records (SumBackward0 → AddmmBackward0 → AccumulateGrad). Backward simply walks this recorded graph, running stored derivatives — inventing nothing.

The series promises honest, runnable proof scripts throughout, establishing a depth meter to track where each future part operates.
chinese_title: 一页尽览 PyTorch
chinese_summary:
# 摘要：一页看尽 PyTorch 全貌 — 第0部分：地图

这篇开篇之作将 PyTorch 的架构从 Python 到芯片划分为八个“楼层”，并使用在 Apple M3 Max 上、torch 2.11.0 环境中运行的可量化验证来勾勒全貌。

**关键层：** `torch._C` 是一个只有 49 KB 的微型存根，它加载真正的框架：`libtorch_cpu.dylib`（206.5 MB）和 `libtorch_python.dylib`（28.5 MB）。用户编写的 Python 代码是最小的一层；编译后的主体占据了主导地位。

**边界：** 每个张量操作都会跨入 C++，在那里，调度器（dispatcher）通过一层层堆栈（autograd、混合精度等）路由调用。一个单元素加法耗时 0.54 微秒——几乎完全是调度机制的开销——将 Python 限制在每秒约 190 万次操作。

**内核：** 存在三千六百七十七个操作名称，每个名称对应到按设备、按数据类型划分的内核实现。调度器每次调用只选择一个。操作列表由 `native_functions.yaml` 和 `derivatives.yaml` 生成。

**两个时钟：** 在 GPU 上，Python 提交任务后立即返回，而芯片在异步计算。在演示中，50 个矩阵乘法排队仅用 1.58 毫秒，但完成它们却花了 73.83 毫秒。这种分离使得 `loss.item()` 代价高昂——它会迫使 Python 等待整个队列执行完毕。

**转折：** `loss.backward()` 之所以有效，是因为前向传播记录了一个 autograd 计算图：一系列函数记录的链（SumBackward0 → AddmmBackward0 → AccumulateGrad）。反向传播只是遍历这个被记录的计算图，运行存储的导数——不会发明任何新东西。

本系列承诺全程提供真实可运行的验证脚本，并建立深度计（depth meter）来追踪未来各部分将在哪一层运作。

title: Show HN: iPhone app takes simultaneous images from 2 lenses, fuses into 1 photo
summary:
Photosynthesis is an iPhone camera app that captures simultaneous images from two rear lenses and fuses them into a single photo. It combines the fine detail of a zoom or telephoto lens with the wider field of view of the main or ultra-wide lens, letting users get both context and high detail without choosing between them. The app uses no generative AI; every pixel comes from real optical captures, though machine learning helps align and color-match the two images.

Key features include a one-press shutter, bracketed framing guides, a built-in editor with alignment and ghosting correction, and export options including layered PSD, spatial/side-by-side 3D, and a re-importable Photosynthesis file. It supports all two-lens iPhones from iPhone 11 onward; Pro iPhones with three lenses can also pair the zoom with the main camera or combine all three lenses in beta.

The app is free for capture, editing, and in-app viewing, with 14 days of full access and then 3 exports per month. An unlimited subscription removes the export limit, adds professional export formats, custom themes/icons, and optional backup to iCloud or a custom folder. Photos are stored in the app, with optional backups. The app focuses on optically real detail, making it suitable for concerts, architecture, and any situation where wide framing and crop-ready sharpness are both important.

title: England set to be one of the first countries to eliminate hepatitis C
summary:
England is on track to become one of the first countries in the world to eliminate hepatitis C, according to new figures. The NHS has already met its target of treating 80% of all known cases, and deaths from the virus have fallen by 36% in the past decade—just short of the 2030 goal.

Hepatitis C is a "silent disease" spread through contact with infected blood, often via needle sharing. It can cause serious liver damage if untreated. Antiviral tablets taken for 8–12 weeks cure more than 95% of cases. Since 2015, over 100,000 people in England have been diagnosed and treated. Initiatives such as A&E blood tests, GP registration testing, and free at-home tests have helped find previously undiagnosed cases.

An additional goal—a 65% reduction in hepatitis C-related mortality compared with 2015 levels—has not yet been met but may be achieved before 2030. Around 50,200 adults in England are living with hepatitis C, and an estimated 84.6% have been diagnosed, slightly below the 90% target.

The Hepatitis C Trust says England is "on the cusp" of a major public health achievement. NHS national medical director Prof Frankie Swords said England is "leading the world" and urged those at higher risk to order free, confidential home-testing kits online. Adults born in countries including Ukraine, Romania, Estonia, Latvia, Poland, Albania, Lithuania, Bulgaria, Czechia, or Slovakia are particularly encouraged to test, as some may have been infected through medical procedures before 1991.

The article also highlights the case of Paul Eatwell, 65, who was treated after a routine blood test, and notes the infected blood scandal from 1970–1991, which left thousands with HIV and hepatitis C.
chinese_title: 英格兰将成为首批消除丙型肝炎的国家之一
chinese_summary:
英格兰有望成为全球首批消除丙型肝炎的国家之一，最新数据显示了这一趋势。英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）已完成对80%已知病例的治疗目标，过去十年间，因该病毒导致的死亡人数下降了36%——距离2030年的目标仅一步之遥。

丙型肝炎是一种“沉默的疾病”，通过接触受感染的血液传播，常见途径包括共用针头。若不及时治疗，可能导致严重的肝脏损伤。服用8至12周的抗病毒药物，可治愈超过95%的病例。自2015年以来，英格兰已有超过10万人被确诊并接受治疗。急诊科血液检测、全科医生注册检测以及免费家庭自测等举措，帮助发现了此前未被诊断的病例。

另一项目标——与2015年相比，将丙型肝炎相关死亡率降低65%——尚未达成，但有望在2030年前实现。英格兰目前约有50,200名成年人携带丙型肝炎病毒，估计其中84.6%已获得确诊，略低于90%的目标。

丙型肝炎信托基金会表示，英格兰正处于一项重大公共卫生成就的“临界点”。NHS国家医学总监弗兰基·斯沃兹教授表示，英格兰“引领世界”，并敦促高风险人群在线订购免费、保密的居家检测试剂盒。出生于乌克兰、罗马尼亚、爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚、波兰、阿尔巴尼亚、立陶宛、保加利亚、捷克或斯洛伐克等国的成年人尤其建议接受检测，因为部分人可能在1991年之前通过医疗程序感染病毒。

文章还重点介绍了65岁的保罗·伊特维尔的案例，他在一次常规血液检测后被成功治疗；同时提及了1970年至1991年间的受污染血液丑闻，该事件导致数千人感染艾滋病毒和丙型肝炎。

title: OpenSSH 10.5/10.5p1
summary:
The article comprises the release notes for OpenSSH 10.5/10.5p1 (released 2026-08-11) and also references the preceding 10.4/10.4p1 release.

OpenSSH 10.5 highlights:

- **Security fixes:**  
  - Fixed an ssh-agent interaction between agent locking and the session-bind extension, which could allow restricted keys or PKCS#11 tokens to be used remotely.  
  - Fixed a potential realloc use-after-free in ssh(1) involving remote forwarding via multiplexed connections.  
  - Ensured the `restrict` keyword in authorized_keys applies to tunnel forwarding.

- **New features:**  
  - ssh-keygen can now set or clear FIDO private key flags (touch-required, verify-required).  
  - ssh(1) tries FIDO keys requiring less user friction first.  
  - New `ssh -Z user@host` mode prints the public-key authentication keys and their order.

- **Potentially incompatible change:** Portable OpenSSH now requires ECC support in libcrypto, including the NISTP521 curve.

- **Bugfixes and portability:** Includes non-blocking server banner reads in ssh-keyscan, fixes for GSSAPI option names, config Match-block handling of ChannelTimeout/RekeyLimit, and re-allowing PAMServiceName inside Match blocks.

OpenSSH 10.4 highlights:

- **Security fixes:** Fixed malicious-server file download path issues in sftp/scp, a pre-auth GSSAPI DoS, internal-sftp argument truncation, and a client-side use-after-free during host-key changes.

- **New features:** Experimental composite post-quantum signature scheme combining ML-DSA 44 and Ed25519, plus an NFA-based pattern matcher to avoid exponential behavior.

- **Incompatible changes:** `sshd -G` now outputs mixed-case directives; Linux seccomp sandbox failures are fatal; and post-auth rekeying is stricter about non-key-exchange messages.

The notes include checksums and instructions for reporting security bugs to openssh@openssh.com.
chinese_title: OpenSSH 10.5/10.5p1
chinese_summary:
本文包含 OpenSSH 10.5/10.5p1（发布于 2026-08-11）的发布说明，并引用了之前的 10.4/10.4p1 版本。

OpenSSH 10.5 主要亮点：

- **安全修复：**  
  - 修复了 ssh-agent 中代理锁定与会话绑定扩展之间的交互问题，该问题可能允许远程使用受限密钥或 PKCS#11 令牌。  
  - 修复了 ssh(1) 中通过多路复用连接进行远程转发时可能出现的 realloc 释放后使用（use-after-free）问题。  
  - 确保 authorized_keys 中的 `restrict` 关键字适用于隧道转发。

- **新功能：**  
  - ssh-keygen 现在可以设置或清除 FIDO 私钥标志（touch-required、verify-required）。  
  - ssh(1) 现在会优先尝试用户操作较少的 FIDO 密钥。  
  - 新增 `ssh -Z user@host` 模式，用于打印公钥认证密钥及其顺序。

- **潜在不兼容变更：** 便携版 OpenSSH 现在要求 libcrypto 支持 ECC，包括 NISTP521 曲线。

- **错误修复和可移植性：** 包括 ssh-keyscan 中的非阻塞服务器横幅读取、GSSAPI 选项名称的修复、配置 Match 块对 ChannelTimeout/RekeyLimit 的处理，以及重新允许在 Match 块内使用 PAMServiceName。

OpenSSH 10.4 主要亮点：

- **安全修复：** 修复了 sftp/scp 中恶意服务器文件下载路径问题、认证前 GSSAPI 拒绝服务（DoS）、internal-sftp 参数截断，以及主机密钥更改期间客户端的释放后使用问题。

- **新功能：** 实验性的复合后量子签名方案，结合了 ML-DSA 44 和 Ed25519，以及基于 NFA 的模式匹配器，以避免指数级行为。

- **不兼容变更：** `sshd -G` 现在输出混合大小写指令；Linux seccomp 沙箱失败被视为致命错误；认证后重新加密对非密钥交换消息更加严格。

这些说明包含校验和以及向 openssh@openssh.com 报告安全漏洞的说明。

title: Jolt: Clojure compiler implemented with Chez Scheme
summary:
Jolt is a Clojure compiler and runtime built on Chez Scheme. It reads Clojure source, compiles it to a host-neutral IR, and emits Scheme, running natively on Chez or via Gambit compiled to JavaScript. The compiler is self-hosted: written in Clojure and compiles itself.

Key features include standalone binaries via `jolt build`, which AOT-compile the runtime, standard library, app, and dependencies into a single executable requiring no Chez, JVM, or source. It supports real concurrency with `future`, `promise`, `agent`, and `pmap` on OS threads, plus `core.async` channels and go blocks. The numeric tower includes exact integers, bignums, exact ratios, and doubles; `=` is category-aware and `==` is value-equality. Persistent data structures use Clojure-compatible semantics: 32-way trie vectors, cons lists, HAMT maps/sets, and transients. It also supports lazy seqs, transducers, destructuring, multimethods, protocols/records, metadata, namespaces, runtime eval, and the full reader.

Quick start options include a Homebrew install, an install script, or running from a cloned repo with Chez Scheme—no build step needed. Usage covers `-e` for expressions, `run` for projects, `-M:test` for aliases, `build` for binaries, and an nREPL server for live development.

Main differences from JVM Clojure: no general Java interop, reflection, gen-class, or proxy (only a shimmed subset of `java.*` plus a C FFI); no BigDecimal; and regex uses irregex instead of `java.util.regex`, so most common patterns work but some Java-specific regex features differ.

title: Show HN: Git-knife – edit commit messages, authors, and dates like a spreadsheet
summary:
git-knife is a desktop GUI for editing Git commit metadata — message, author/committer name/email, author date, and committer date — in a spreadsheet-like interface. It fills a gap: polished GUIs (GitKraken, Sublime Merge, Fork, lazygit) handle rewording/reordering but treat dates and author identity as immutable; CLI tools like git-filter-repo can rewrite them but lack a GUI.

The app shells out to the system Git CLI and rebuilds commits with `git commit-tree`, reusing each commit’s original tree so file contents are provably unchanged. It supports bulk find & replace (literal or regex) across text fields, previews every change, and creates an automatic backup ref (`refs/knife-backup/...`) before each rewrite with one-click restore. It warns when rewriting already-pushed history and recommends `git push --force-with-lease`. Merge commits are locked in the MVP; reorder/squash/drop are planned.

A transparent signature note is attached to rewritten tips via a separate notes ref (`refs/notes/git-knife`) — visible, not hidden, and toggleable.

The app is built with Tauri (Rust backend, Node.js frontend). Requirements: Git 2.x, Node.js + pnpm, Rust, and Linux WebKitGTK dependencies. Run with `pnpm tauri dev`, build with `pnpm tauri build`. GitHub Actions provide unsigned installers for macOS, Linux, and Windows.

Safety features: the rewrite uses a compare-and-swap on the old tip, never force-deletes, and stores a backup ref before any change. The underlying engine is validated by a shell script that reproduces the commit-tree flow and asserts an empty content diff.
chinese_title: Show HN: Git-knife——像编辑电子表格一样编辑提交信息、作者和日期

git-knife 是一款桌面 GUI 工具，用于在类似电子表格的界面中编辑 Git 提交元数据——提交信息、作者/提交者姓名/邮箱、作者日期和提交者日期。它填补了一个空白：成熟的 GUI 工具（GitKraken、Sublime Merge、Fork、lazygit）可以处理重新措辞和重新排序，但将日期和作者身份视为不可变；而 git-filter-repo 等 CLI 工具可以重写它们，但缺乏 GUI。

该应用调用系统 Git CLI，并使用 `git commit-tree` 重建提交，复用每个提交的原始树，从而可证明文件内容未被更改。它支持跨文本字段的批量查找和替换（字面量或正则表达式），预览每项更改，并在每次重写前创建自动备份引用（`refs/knife-backup/...`），支持一键恢复。当重写已推送的历史时，它会发出警告，并建议使用 `git push --force-with-lease`。在 MVP 中，合并提交被锁定；重新排序/压缩/丢弃功能已在规划中。

通过单独的 notes 引用（`refs/notes/git-knife`）将透明的签名注释附加到重写后的 tip 提交上——可见、不隐藏、可切换。

该应用使用 Tauri 构建（Rust 后端，Node.js 前端）。

安全特性：重写过程对旧 tip 使用比较并交换（compare-and-swap）操作，绝不强制删除，并在任何更改前存储备份引用。底层引擎通过一个 shell 脚本验证，该脚本重现 commit-tree 流程并断言内容差异为空。

title: Manus will return to operating as an independent company
summary:
Manus 即将恢复为独立公司运营。由于 Manus 与 Meta 分拆，为遵守特定司法辖区的监管要求，部分用户于 2025 年 12 月 29 日（Meta 收购 Manus 之日）当天或之后产生的数据，将在 2026 年 8 月 23 日 08:00 至 8 月 24 日期间（SGT）被删除。

受影响用户需注意以下时间节点：
- 备份窗口：即日起至 2026 年 8 月 23 日 07:59（SGT），可使用备份工具多次备份；备份后如有新数据请再次备份。
- 无法访问时段：2026 年 8 月 23 日至 8 月 24 日（SGT），预计约两天。
- 数据恢复：2026 年 8 月 25 日 08:00（SGT）起可恢复备份数据并正常使用。

通知方式：Manus 将通过应用内通知和电子邮件告知受影响用户；使用 Apple ID 或 Facebook 注册的用户需留意应用内通知。用户也可在帮助中心查询账户是否受影响。备份期间（8 月 11 日至 8 月 23 日）不会向受影响用户收费，恢复数据后还将提供回归奖励。

官方强调：此举措并非数据泄露或安全事件，而是独立运营过渡和监管合规所需。独立后用户数据存储在美国和新加坡。Manus 表示将在整个过程中提供支持，并继续迭代产品。

title: Your phone is the most intricate machine you've ever held. Let's take it apart.
summary: Phone screens are coated with an oleophobic (oil-repelling) fluoropolymer, a nanoscale non-stick layer that makes your fingertip glide smoothly instead of dragging. This coating, introduced with the iPhone 3GS in 2009, works like a non-stick pan: its carbon chains have fluorine atoms instead of hydrogen, forming incredibly stable carbon-fluorine bonds. These bonds give the surface very low surface energy, so oily fingerprints wipe off easily and your thumb feels a gliding sensation. However, the coating is only one molecule thick and wears away gradually with every touch. It also explains why a phone left face-down on even a slight slope tends to slide off on its own.
chinese_title: 你的手机是你拿过的最精密的机器。让我们把它拆开。

title: As AI eats the web, the internet’s collective memory is disappearing
summary:
The article argues that the internet’s collective memory is collapsing because AI search tools and commercial platforms are undermining the web’s role as a reliable archive. Google’s AI summaries now invent basic facts, such as incorrect sunset times, showing that dominant search systems increasingly obscure original sources rather than point to them. This is compounded by link rot, deleted websites, and AI-generated content polluting search results.

Key examples of digital erasure include Disney deleting FiveThirtyEight’s entire archive after shutting it down, Wikipedia seeing reduced traffic as AI systems scrape its content without sending users back to the site, and the Internet Archive facing both cyberattacks and lawsuits that limit its ability to preserve the web. Ephemeral formats like Instagram Stories also mean much modern communication is never archived at all.

The article calls for treating information as public infrastructure, not a free service owned by foreign tech giants. It highlights European pushback: France uses Qwant and Tchap, and a German court ruled Google can be held liable for false AI-generated statements. In Canada, the author urges investment in public-interest digital systems, similar to past initiatives like CANARIE and SchoolNet. The central message is that preserving and accessing cultural memory must become a sovereign public priority, not left to volunteerism or profit-driven platforms.
chinese_title: 随着AI吞噬网络，互联网的集体记忆正在消失

title: Apple Silicon and macOS VMs: Faster LLM Inference with llama.cpp
summary:
A research release from Lume/Cua describes a method to dramatically speed up LLM inference inside macOS virtual machines on Apple Silicon. macOS VMs using Apple's Virtualization.framework report a conservative Metal capability profile to guest applications, causing llama.cpp to select slower GPU kernels. The authors built a small, process-scoped compatibility shim that intercepts Metal capability queries and changes two answers: it reports support for Apple family 9 (previously family 5) and raises maximum threadgroup memory from 32 KB to 64 KB. This lets llama.cpp enable SIMD-group matrix, SIMD-group reduction, and bfloat16 paths while still using the paravirtualized GPU.

On an M1 Ultra with a Tahoe guest, TinyLlama 1.1B prompt processing jumped from 432 to 4,787 tok/s (11.08× faster, 98% of bare metal) and token generation from 12.63 to 206.60 tok/s (16.36× faster, 72% of host). Gemma 4 12B improved 7.20× on prompt (515.76 tok/s) and 14.54× on generation (49.67 tok/s). Muse Glimmer 30B improved 7.55× on prompt and 8.87× on generation. MLX-LM performance was unchanged. The release includes source, build scripts, and raw logs.

The shim is version-sensitive, per-process, and limited to tested configurations. It requires setting a host preference and injecting the dylib into the target process. The authors invite testing across other chips and macOS versions, and clarify that this is not physical GPU passthrough but an unlocking of Apple's existing virtualized GPU path.

title: Nvidia's Risky Business

title: CSS properties you should know for better text designs
summary: This article covers five CSS properties that can improve and add interest to web typography. 1. **`background-clip`** – Using `background-clip: text` with a background image or gradient and `color: transparent` fills letterforms with the background, creating eye-catching image-based text. 2. **`vertical-align` / `align-content`** – `vertical-align` aligns inline elements (like ``, ``, or ``) within a line of text. It does not vertically center text inside a container. For that, `align-content` can be used on block boxes—no Grid or Flexbox required. 3. **`box-decoration-mode`** – When text breaks across lines, `box-decoration-break: clone` applies borders, padding, shadows, and border-radius to each line fragment individually, giving uniform styling at every broken edge. 4. **`letter-spacing`** – This property controls the space around each glyph, accepting both positive and negative values. It can also be animated to create text reveal effects by expanding spacing and changing color. 5. **`text-combine-upright`** – Used with vertical writing modes, this property lets short horizontal text (like numbers, dates, or abbreviations) sit inside vertical text as a compact upright block. The article concludes that these five properties offer a solid starting point for more detailed and creative CSS typography design.

title: H3-metal – Native MiniMax-H3 inference for Apple Silicon
summary:
h3-metal is a native Metal implementation of MiniMax-H3 inference optimized for Apple Silicon (currently M3 Max/M5 Max). It supports prompt-to-video/audio, first/last-frame conditioning, and ordered Ref2VA image/video/audio references. The CLI offers `--info`, interactive sessions, and flags for profiles, resolution, frames, steps, layers, reuse, token reduction, internal canvas, SSD streaming, and int8 row FC2.

A balanced fast configuration uses 22 frames at 24 fps, 512×512, 20 denoising steps, 45 of 50 layers, and `--reuse 2`, producing around 0.92-second videos. Four-step runs are used for very short iterations. `--ssd-streaming` keeps only two DiT blocks resident, reducing DiT storage from ~36.5 GiB to ~2.0 GiB at 512×512 at the cost of slower forward passes. Quality-oriented settings restore all 50 layers, 50 steps, and reuse 1.

The controls table summarizes: steps (actual denoising passes), reuse (fresh DiT evaluations), layers (active transformer blocks), core-reuse, token reduction, and internal render size. Resolution limits require width/height multiples of 32, with 512×512 safest, 768×768 validated close-quality, and 768p-class limits like 1344×768. `--seconds` converts at 24 fps and rounds to legal H3 temporal shapes.

Prompt guidance recommends Context-IR-like descriptions: subject, action, setting, camera, lighting/style, and sound. `--show` provides terminal previews; `--frames-dir` writes PPM frames; `--profile` reports timing, memory, and dispatch counts. First/last-frame anchors and Ref2VA references are supported, with commands like `!first`, `!last`, `!ref-image`, and `!refs` for interactive session use.

title: What I learned by putting GitHub Copilot behind a MitM proxy
summary:
The author placed GitHub Copilot inside VS Code behind a mitmproxy (a man-in-the-middle proxy) to reverse-engineer its network traffic and understand how it works under the hood. Because most AI desktop apps are built on Electron, the findings likely apply across similar tools.

Key findings:

- **Bootstrap behavior:** Before the user types anything, Copilot makes requests for authentication/OAuth, entitlements, configuration/policy, model discovery, and recent repositories.

- **Model routing:** In “Auto” mode, Copilot first sends the prompt to a `/models/session/intent` endpoint to classify intent (code-gen, debugging, reasoning, tool-use), then selects a model accordingly.

- **Context leakage via inline completions:** The author placed a fake secret in a `.env` file (with Copilot disabled for `.env`) and then typed in an unrelated `pyproject.toml`. The completion request still included the `.env` contents in context, because the request was triggered by keystrokes in the other file. Disabling Copilot for a specific file type doesn’t stop its content from being included when triggered from other files.

- **Chronicle / session-store.db:** Copilot has a built-in tool called `session_store_sql` that queries a local SQLite database (`session-store.db`) containing past prompts, responses, sessions, branches, and repos. The model can run read-only SQL queries to recall what the user worked on, discovering the schema dynamically through trial and error.

The broader takeaway: AI coding assistants are building a persistent, queryable memory of your work. Context—your code, history, and attention—is becoming the product, and it increasingly lives in local databases that the model can access on demand.
chinese_title: 我通过将GitHub Copilot置于中间人代理后面所学到的
chinese_summary:
作者将VS Code中的GitHub Copilot置于mitmproxy（中间人代理）之后，对其网络流量进行逆向工程，以理解其底层工作原理。由于大多数AI桌面应用都基于Electron构建，这些发现很可能适用于同类工具。

关键发现：

- **启动行为：** 在用户输入任何内容之前，Copilot就会发起身份验证/OAuth、权限、配置/策略、模型发现以及最近仓库的请求。

- **模型路由：** 在“自动”模式下，Copilot首先将提示词发送到`/models/session/intent`端点，以分类意图（代码生成、调试、推理、工具使用），然后据此选择模型。

- **通过内联补全导致上下文泄露：** 作者在一个`.env`文件中放置了一个假密钥（且已对`.env`禁用Copilot），然后在无关的`pyproject.toml`中键入内容。补全请求仍然将`.env`的内容包含在上下文中，因为该请求是由另一个文件中的按键触发的。对特定文件类型禁用Copilot，并不能阻止其内容在其他文件触发时被包含。

- **Chronicle / session-store.db：** Copilot内置了一个名为`session_store_sql`的工具，用于查询一个本地SQLite数据库（`session-store.db`），其中包含过去的提示词、响应、会话、分支和仓库。模型可以执行只读SQL查询来回忆用户之前处理的内容，并通过反复试错动态发现数据库模式。

更广泛的结论：AI编程助手正在为你的工作构建一种持久、可查询的记忆。上下文——你的代码、历史和关注点——正成为产品本身，并且越来越多地存在于模型可以按需访问的本地数据库中。

title: Archive of Animal Photography Reveals 18,000 Species and Counting
summary:
Joel Sartore’s National Geographic Photo Ark project has photographed its 18,000th species: the critically endangered red handfish. The project began in 2006 after Sartore photographed a naked mole-rat at a Nebraska zoo while caring for his wife during her cancer treatment. That experience gave him a new perspective on life’s fragility, inspiring a photographic record of Earth’s animal diversity.

Sartore photographs animals in human care—zoos, aquariums, sanctuaries, and labs—using plain black or white backdrops to let each creature stand alone. He aims to show all visually observable species, from insects to mammals, and to spark public care for conservation while there is still time. The archive includes extinct-in-the-wild species and even a preserved thylacine.

The project also supports on-the-ground efforts. In Florida’s Pine Rocklands, Photo Ark funding helped draw attention to overlooked insects like the Miami tiger beetle. In Ecuador, it has highlighted amphibian losses, including the rediscovered longnose harlequin frog, whose skin may hold biomedical uses. Nearly 41% of amphibian species are threatened globally.

Now 64, Sartore’s son Cole is being trained to take over the project. Sartore plans to photograph roughly 25,000 species in human care worldwide. He hopes viewers will see his images, recognize what exists, and make the choice to save it.

title: Go is an ideal language for AI-assisted software engineering
summary:
The article argues that Go is uniquely suited for the AI-assisted software engineering era. With AI generating large volumes of code, the developer’s primary role shifts from writing code to reviewing, verifying, and maintaining it. Go was designed for exactly this kind of team-driven, long-term software engineering.

Key strengths include:

- **A complete platform:** Go ships with a built-in formatter, test framework, dependency management, and security tools. This consistency helps both human teams and AI agents produce uniform, higher-quality code. A coherent ecosystem also creates cleaner training data for LLMs.

- **Readability over writability:** Go enforces standardized formatting and simple syntax, making all code look the same, whether written by a human or an AI. Predictability helps reviewers quickly spot hallucinations, logic flaws, or vulnerabilities.

- **Reliability:** Go’s static type system catches errors early, and its fast compiler allows AI agents to iterate quickly. The extensive standard library reduces risky third-party dependencies. Go’s checksum database, module mirror, and `govulncheck` address supply-chain security. Native test and fuzzing tools validate code thoroughly.

- **Maintainability:** Go’s compatibility promise means code written years ago still compiles, preventing breakage. Tools like `gopls` and modernizers in `go fix` keep codebases and the ecosystem uniform, combating architectural drift. Built-in profiling, tracing, and profile-guided optimization support closed-loop performance tuning.

In summary, Go’s emphasis on clarity, platform uniformity, reliability, and long-term maintainability makes it an ideal language when AI serves as a teammate and humans focus on supervision and verification.
chinese_title: Go是AI辅助软件工程的理想语言
chinese_summary:
本文认为，Go 语言非常适合 AI 辅助的软件工程时代。随着 AI 生成大量代码，开发者的主要角色从编写代码转变为审查、验证和维护代码。Go 正是为这种团队驱动、长期维护的软件工程而设计的。

主要优势包括：

- **完整的平台：** Go 内置了格式化工具、测试框架、依赖管理和安全工具。这种一致性有助于人类团队和 AI 代理生成统一、更高质量的代码。连贯的生态系统也为大语言模型提供了更干净的训练数据。

- **可读性优先于可写性：** Go 强制统一的格式化和简单的语法，使所有代码看起来都一样，无论是人类还是 AI 编写的。可预测性帮助审查者快速发现幻觉、逻辑缺陷或安全漏洞。

- **可靠性：** Go 的静态类型系统能及早捕获错误，其快速编译器允许 AI 代理快速迭代。丰富的标准库减少了对有风险的第三方依赖。Go 的校验和数据库、模块镜像和 `govulncheck` 解决了供应链安全问题。原生测试和模糊测试工具能全面验证代码。

- **可维护性：** Go 的兼容性承诺确保几年前编写的代码仍然可以编译，防止破坏。`gopls` 等工具和 `go fix` 中的现代化工具保持了代码库和生态系统的统一，遏制了架构漂移。内置的性能分析、跟踪和性能分析引导优化支持闭环性能调优。

总之，Go 对清晰性、平台统一性、可靠性和长期可维护性的重视，使其在 AI 作为队友而人类专注于监督和验证时成为理想的语言。

title: Bluesky's active user base is shrinking as its focus expands beyond the app
summary:
Bluesky’s early post-election momentum has faded significantly. According to Similarweb, its mobile app had 10.4 million monthly active users worldwide in June 2026, down 27.2% year-over-year, while daily active users fell 25.6% in July to about 3 million. This represents a loss of more than half of its peak monthly active users from late 2024. However, the retained community is engaged, with a stickiness rate around 29%, similar to Threads.

New CEO Toni Schneider is reportedly less focused on the Bluesky app itself, instead prioritizing the underlying AT Protocol to power a growing ecosystem of social apps and services. Projects like BlackSky, Eurosky, and the video-focused Skylight are gaining traction. Bluesky has also launched an AI research tool called Attie and is working on private data support, which could attract users interested in private networking rather than public discourse.

The decline does not appear to be driven by users returning to X. X’s mobile monthly active users were down about 3% year-over-year in June, and daily active users dropped 7% in July to 123.7 million. Instead, Threads is the platform to watch: its daily active users rose 21.3% year-over-year to 147 million in July, and web visits surged 112%. Bluesky reports nearly 46 million registered users, but does not disclose active usage metrics. The article suggests Bluesky’s strategic shift beyond its own app could be intentional, but its engagement decline raises questions about long-term retention.

title: The Tradeoffs Facing Japan's Economy
summary:
Japan's economy faces severe tradeoffs amid a weak yen, high debt, and inflation-driven consumer pain. With a debt-to-GDP ratio over 200%, the government under Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi must balance competing pressures.

**Key challenges:** Inflation hovers at 1.7%, but food prices have risen 3.2% (fish/seafood 6.9%). Energy subsidies mask fuel costs. Takaichi's approval dropped from 69% to 57% in July, with 71% disapproving of her cost-of-living strategy.

**Tradeoff 1 – Interest rates:** The Bank of Japan kept rates at 1%. Higher rates could fight inflation and discourage the yen carry trade, but would raise borrowing costs for consumers and hurt bondholders. Japan's four largest life insurers already lost ~$96 billion in Q2 2026 from interest rate rises.

**Tradeoff 2 – Consumer support vs. debt:** The government plans to cut the food tax from 8% to 1% (costing ~$32 billion) and spends billions on fuel subsidies. But 10.7% of the $780 billion budget already goes to debt interest, and these costs are projected to rise 50%. Some warn of a "Liz Truss" bond-market moment.

**Energy and defense:** Japan relies on imports for 83.5% of its energy, which worsens the trade deficit and weakens the yen. The government is reviving nuclear power (target: 20% by 2040) and boosting defense exports, including Patriot missiles, to offset trade imbalances.

**Long-term plan:** A $2.3 trillion public-private investment strategy to 2040 across 17 sectors (AI, semiconductors, energy, defense) aims to outgrow debt. But financing will require more borrowing, and political sustainability is uncertain.

The US–Japan currency intervention was short-term relief. Risks remain: waning support for Takaichi, a bond run, or prolonged wars in Iran and Ukraine. The article concludes Japan is at a crossroads, with promising long-term ambitions threatened by immediate constraints.
chinese_title: 日本经济面临的权衡抉择
chinese_summary:
日本经济在日元疲软、高额债务和通胀引发的消费者困境中面临严峻权衡。在债务与GDP之比超过200%的情况下，首相高市早苗领导的政府必须在多重压力之间取得平衡。

**主要挑战：**通胀率徘徊在1.7%，但食品价格上涨了3.2%（鱼类/海产品上涨6.9%）。能源补贴掩盖了燃料成本。高市的支持率从7月的69%降至57%，71%的受访者不认可她的生活成本应对策略。

**权衡一——利率：**日本央行将利率维持在1%。提高利率可以抑制通胀并阻止日元套利交易，但会推高消费者的借贷成本并损害债券持有人的利益。日本四大寿险公司已在2026年第二季度因利率上升损失约960亿美元。

**权衡二——消费者支持与债务：**政府计划将食品税从8%降至1%（耗资约320亿美元），并投入数十亿美元用于燃料补贴。但7800亿美元预算中已有10.7%用于支付债务利息，而这些成本预计将上升50%。一些人警告可能出现“利兹·特拉斯式”的债券市场危机时刻。

**能源与国防：**日本83.5%的能源依赖进口，这加剧了贸易逆差并削弱了日元。政府正在重启核电（目标：到2040年核电占比20%）并扩大国防出口（包括“爱国者”导弹），以抵消贸易失衡。

**长期规划：**一项面向2040年的2.3万亿美元公私合作投资战略，涵盖17个领域（人工智能、半导体、能源、国防），旨在实现经济增长超越债务增长。但融资将需要更多借贷，政治可持续性也存在不确定性。

美日货币干预只是短期缓解。风险依然存在：高市支持率的下降、债券抛售潮，或伊朗和乌克兰战事的长期化。文章总结道，日本正处于十字路口，雄心勃勃的长期愿景正受到紧迫现实约束的威胁。

title: Show HN: Needle2: 14MB agentic LLM for phones, wearables, smart home and robots
summary:
Needle 2 is a 45-million-parameter agentic language model compressed to 14MB, targeting low-cost edge devices like phones, wearables, smart home hubs, and robots. It runs on hardware without GPU/NPU and uses as little as 28MB session RAM, achieving 800+ tok/s prefill and 500+ tok/s decode on a Raspberry Pi 5.

The model is specialized for function calling and structured extraction rather than general chat. It maps natural-language commands to typed tool calls, producing grammar-valid JSON. It also returns confidence scores so off-topic queries can be escalated to cloud models when needed. Needle 2 uses “Cactus Quants” 2-bit quantization trained from the start, avoiding the quality loss of post-hoc compression. Its architecture combines a fixed Walsh-Hadamard transform, hashed n-gram “engram” memory, multi-lane residual streams, and a 256-token sliding KV cache, keeping memory bounded and compute minimal—about 70 MFLOPs per token versus hundreds for comparable models.

The model is pretrained on 115B tokens plus 38B post-training tokens focused on device actions and extraction. On Mobile Actions, it scores 63.7% strict exact match, near larger models like FunctionGemma (270M) and LFM2.5 (230M), while beating Apple FM. It also shows strong generalization on Seal-Tools and competitive results on BFCL v4, though weaker on out-of-distribution Java/JavaScript categories. Needle ships as a single C++ binary with self-tuning kernels for ARM, x86, and WebAssembly. It is production-ready and already used locally in the Pebble Index 01 app for offline voice actions.

该模型专攻函数调用和结构化信息提取，而非通用对话。它能将自然语言指令映射为类型化工具调用，生成语法合法的JSON。模型还会返回置信度分数，以便在必要时将离题查询升级至云端模型处理。Needle 2采用从头训练的"Cactus Quants"2比特量化技术，避免了事后压缩带来的质量损失。其架构融合了固定沃尔什-阿达玛变换、哈希n元语法"印迹"记忆、多通道残差流以及256令牌滑动KV缓存，将内存占用控制在有限范围内并最大限度降低计算量——每令牌约70 MFLOPs，而同类模型则需要数百MFLOPs。

title: Halcyon Video – a 3D video store for your media server
summary:
Halcyon Video is a 3D video storefront that rebuilds your Jellyfin media library as a walkable 1990s rental shop. Every title becomes a VHS or DVD case on real shelving; you can browse aisles, flip over boxes for metadata, search via an in-store CRT terminal, “rent” tapes with a soft-body bag, and watch the movie in a virtual living room. It’s built with Vite, TypeScript, and three.js, and runs 24/7 on an HTPC while idling at near-zero CPU/GPU when unused. A live demo with a synthetic 2,000-title library is available.

The store is highly customizable: you can switch between era-specific themes (1990, 1993, 2000, 2010, plus “Night Owl Video”), lighting conditions (day/sunset/night with measured HDR skies), floor plans, and media formats. Rebranding is done by dropping in a logo — colors, signage, and wrap designs are all data, not code.

Integrations include Jellyfin (required), RomM for a games department with per-platform boxes and launchers, and Jellyseerr for discovery: collection gaps, trending titles, and staff picks appear as requestable cases. Duplicate quality versions collapse to one box, and a smart recommendation clerk offers provable reasons based on your library.

A 2.5D HTML/CSS mode runs on Raspberry Pi, and Remote Play streams the live store to phones via WebRTC. Playback supports direct play with HLS fallback, mpv off-disk, and Jellyfin playback reporting. The manager terminal provides diegetic system control, and optional “rental mode” enforces early-90s due-back rules. Whole experience is designed to feel like a real store, not a menu with a skin.

title: Chicken Scheme 6.0
summary:
The article is a set of release notes for **CHICKEN Scheme**, covering versions 6.0.0, 5.4.0, and 5.3.0.

**6.0.0 highlights:**
- Full support for all R7RS small language modules in the core.
- Internal strings are now UTF-8, making the system fully Unicode-capable.
- Blobs replaced by R7RS-compatible bytevectors; `#${...}` syntax removed.
- File I/O now supports encodings (UTF-8 default, Latin-1).
- Process APIs return process objects instead of PIDs; file locking simplified.
- Several primitives moved to R7RS modules; `define-record-type` is now generative.
- FFI permits direct passing of strings/symbols and complex numbers/C structs.
- Tools changes: “feathers” debugger moved to an egg; `csc` handles spaced tool paths differently.
- Compiler adds closure reuse/sharing optimizations.
- Build system now uses a `configure` script; old mingw build dropped, “zig cc” supported.

**5.4.0:**
- Security fix for CVE-2022-45145 (egg metadata command injection).
- Runtime option `-:b` removed; option processing hardened.
- New thread-safe signal API, finalizers, weak pairs, and other library additions.

**5.3.0:**
- Fixes for process-context setters, irregex regex edge cases, and type declarations.
- `current-milliseconds` deprecated in favor of `current-process-milliseconds`.
- Default file-open mode changed to 0666.

The notes emphasize R7RS compliance, Unicode, bytevector migration, API modernization, security hardening, and build/toolchain improvements.

title: Don't Look Up
summary:
A “Don't Look Up” piece argues the AI boom is a fragile bubble propped up by two unprofitable companies: OpenAI and Anthropic. Major bank analysts (Wells Fargo, Barclays, UBS) estimate that 70%+ of Microsoft, Google, and Amazon’s AI revenues come from these two labs. Their cloud growth increasingly depends on Anthropic/OpenAI compute spending, which is unsustainable without massive outside funding.

Key points:
- OpenAI and Anthropic are projected to spend ~$100 billion on compute in 2026, requiring $217 billion raised in H1 2026 alone.
- To sustain hyperscaler growth, they may need to spend $200+ billion on cloud compute in 2027, requiring $250–300 billion in funding.
- Analysts estimate AI will drive large shares of cloud revenue: 33% of Azure (FY2027), 48% of Google Cloud (2027), 60% of AWS growth.
- Most demand for AI compute is concentrated in these two labs; other customers are negligible. Even Microsoft’s non-OpenAI AI revenue is only in low-single-digit billions.
- Hyperscalers are spending trillions on capex and taking on massive debt ($250B this year, $400B next) to build capacity, but end-user ROI is questionable.
- The author dismisses counterarguments: growth isn’t enough, backlogs aren’t proof of demand, and this isn’t like the dot-com bubble.
- Core risk: the most profitable AI layers depend on the least profitable ones endlessly raising capital. When that stops, the whole chain faces collapse.
chinese_title: 不要抬头
chinese_summary:
一篇“别抬头”式的文章认为，AI繁荣是一个由两家不盈利公司——OpenAI和Anthropic——支撑起来的脆弱泡沫。大型银行分析师（富国银行、巴克莱、瑞银）估计，微软、谷歌和亚马逊AI收入的70%以上来自这两个实验室。它们的云增长越来越依赖于Anthropic/OpenAI的算力支出，而这种支出在没有大规模外部资金注入的情况下是不可持续的。

要点：
- OpenAI和Anthropic预计2026年将在算力上花费约1000亿美元，仅2026年上半年就需要筹集2170亿美元。
- 为了维持超大规模云厂商的增长，它们2027年可能需要花费2000亿美元以上用于云算力，这需要2500亿至3000亿美元的资金。
- 分析师估计，AI将推动云收入的很大一部分：Azure的33%（2027财年）、谷歌云的48%（2027年）、AWS增长的60%。
- 对AI算力的大部分需求集中在这两个实验室；其他客户微不足道。即使是微软非OpenAI的AI收入也仅有低两位数亿美元级别。
- 超大规模云厂商正在花费数万亿美元的资本支出并背负巨额债务（今年2500亿美元，明年4000亿美元）来建设产能，但终端用户的投资回报率令人质疑。
- 作者驳斥了各种反方观点：增长不够，积压订单不能证明需求，而且这与互联网泡沫不同。
- 核心风险：最赚钱的AI层依赖于最不赚钱的层不断筹集资金。当这种情况停止时，整个链条将面临崩溃。

title: To save C, we must save ABI (2022)
summary:
The article argues that while ABI (Application Binary Interface) stability is often a constraint that prevents innovation, C’s ABI must be preserved to avoid catastrophic system breakage. It explains that ABI is the low-level contract governing how functions and structs are represented in machine code, including register usage, argument passing, and memory layout.

Using a concrete example, the author shows that changing a function parameter from `long long` to `__int128_t` changes the assembly: the 64-bit version passes one register (`rdi`), while the 128-bit version uses two (`rdi` and `rsi`). This demonstrates how compilers forge binary-level expectations invisible at the source level.

The core problem: C does not mangle function names, unlike C++, so the linker only cares about symbol names, not types. As a result, mismatched declarations and definitions can silently link and then fail at runtime. The author demonstrates this by declaring `long long do_stuff(long long)` but defining `__int128_t do_stuff(__int128_t)`; the linker accepts it and the program behaves unpredictably.

Even proper headers don’t fully protect against ABI breaks because shared libraries expose symbols whose actual implementations may differ from the headers an application was compiled against. On *nix systems, package maintainers must ensure binary compatibility across entire distributions; an ABI mismatch can cause segfaults, memory corruption, or subtle failures far from the true cause.

The article concludes that despite ABI stability’s drawbacks—such as forcing implementers to keep outdated types or delaying new features by years—it is essential to maintain C’s ABI. Without saving ABI, we cannot save C itself from fragmenting into incompatible ecosystems.
chinese_title: 为了拯救C，我们必须拯救ABI（2022）
chinese_summary:
文章认为，虽然ABI（应用二进制接口）稳定性常常是阻碍创新的约束条件，但C语言的ABI必须加以保留，以避免灾难性的系统崩溃。文章解释了ABI是支配函数和结构体在机器码中如何表示的低层契约，包括寄存器使用、参数传递和内存布局。

作者通过一个具体示例说明，将函数参数从`long long`改为`__int128_t`会改变汇编代码：64位版本只传递一个寄存器（`rdi`），而128位版本使用两个寄存器（`rdi`和`rsi`）。这展示了编译器如何在源码层面不可见的情况下构建二进制级别的预期。

核心问题在于：C语言不像C++那样对函数名进行修饰（name mangling），因此链接器只关心符号名称，而不关心类型。结果，不匹配的声明和定义可以静默地链接成功，然后在运行时失败。作者通过声明`long long do_stuff(long long)`但定义`__int128_t do_stuff(__int128_t)`来演示这一点；链接器接受了这一代码，而程序行为变得不可预测。

即使有正确的头文件，也无法完全防止ABI破坏，因为共享库暴露的符号，其实际实现可能与应用程序编译时所依据的头文件不同。在*nix系统上，软件包维护者必须确保整个发行版的二进制兼容性；ABI不匹配可能导致段错误、内存损坏，或远离真正原因的难以察觉的故障。

文章总结道，尽管ABI稳定性有其弊端——例如迫使实现者保留过时的类型，或将新功能推迟数年——但维护C语言的ABI至关重要。若不保留ABI，就无法保护C语言本身免于分裂为互不兼容的生态系统。

title: LFM2.5 2.6B model competitive with 4x larger models
summary: The article highlights LFM2.5, a 2.6-billion-parameter language model that performs competitively with models roughly four times its size (around 10B parameters). It includes a collection of both base and post-trained versions of the LFM2.5 model, comprising 16 items in total. The collection was updated seven days ago and has received 195 likes, indicating community interest. Overall, the key takeaway is the model's impressive efficiency and strong performance relative to its much larger counterparts.
chinese_title: LFM2.5 2.6B模型可与4倍大的模型相媲美
chinese_summary: 文章重点介绍了LFM2.5，这是一个拥有26亿参数的语言模型，其性能与约为其四倍大小（约100亿参数）的模型相当。该合集包含LFM2.5模型的基础版和后期训练版本，共计16项。该合集于七天前更新，已获得195个点赞，显示出社区关注度。总体而言，关键信息在于该模型相对于其更大规模的同类模型所展现出的出色效率与强劲性能。

title: Show HN: Scroll through all 43252003274489856000 Rubik's Cube states
summary: The post introduces an interactive project that lets users “scroll through” every possible Rubik’s Cube state — exactly **43,252,003,274,489,856,000** (≈4.3×10¹⁹) configurations. Each state is represented as a permutation, and the tool indexes them so users can browse through the enormous sequence. Progress is shown in large scale increments (1.1×10¹⁹, 2.2×10¹⁹, 3.2×10¹⁹, etc.), highlighting the immense combinatorial size of the puzzle. It also features well-known cube states like the **Superflip** and **Checkerboard** as reference points. Overall, it’s a creative demonstration of the scope of Rubik’s Cube permutations.
chinese_title: Show HN：滚动浏览所有43252003274489856000个魔方状态
chinese_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个交互式项目，让用户可以“滚动浏览”魔方的每一种可能状态——正好有 **43,252,003,274,489,856,000**（约4.3×10¹⁹）种配置。每种状态都以排列的形式呈现，该工具为它们建立索引，使用户能够浏览这个庞大的序列。进度以大规模增量方式显示（1.1×10¹⁹、2.2×10¹⁹、3.2×10¹⁹ 等），凸显了魔方巨大的组合规模。项目还收录了 **Superflip**（超级翻转）和 **Checkerboard**（棋盘格）等著名魔方状态作为参照点。总的来说，这是对魔方排列范围的一次创造性展示。

title: How Claude marks AI-generated content
summary:
Anthropic has signed the EU AI Act’s Article 50(2) Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content and is implementing marking for Claude outputs.

Key commitments:

- **New models**: Claude models launched in the EU on or after August 2, 2026 will support machine-readable marking at launch.
- **Global coverage**: Marking applies to output from supported Claude models worldwide, across Claude Platform (API), Claude, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Claude Tag, as well as via AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry where supported.
- **Existing models**: Anthropic is working to add marking support to models released before the cutoff date.
- **Detection**: Anthropic will help users and third parties detect Claude marks, with detailed documentation to follow.

How marking works:

1. **Embedded text watermarks**: Claude weaves an invisible watermark into generated text. It does not affect meaning, quality, or readability, and it persists through copying, pasting, and some editing.
2. **Signed provenance metadata**: For supported file types (e.g., .svg, .png, .jpg), Claude attaches C2PA-standard signed metadata, indicating the file was processed by Claude and enabling tamper detection.

Limitations:

- A detected mark indicates content may have been processed by Claude but does not confirm full provenance; Claude may not be the original author, and content can be altered afterward.
- Lack of a mark does not prove content is not AI-generated. Marks can be absent due to older models, heavy editing/paraphrasing, very short text, stripped metadata, or unsupported platforms/features.

Anthropic advises developers building with Claude to independently assess their own obligations under Article 50 and says it will share technical guidance on marking and detection as it becomes available.
chinese_title: 克劳德如何标记AI生成的内容
chinese_summary:
Anthropic已签署《欧盟人工智能法案》第50(2)条关于AI生成内容透明度的《实践守则》，并正在为Claude的输出实施标记。

主要承诺：

- **新模型**：2026年8月2日或之后在欧盟发布的Claude模型将在发布时支持机器可读标记。
- **全球覆盖**：标记适用于全球范围内受支持的Claude模型输出，涵盖Claude平台（API）、Claude、Claude Code、Claude Cowork和Claude Tag，以及通过AWS、Google Cloud和Microsoft Foundry提供的服务（在支持的情况下）。
- **现有模型**：Anthropic正在努力为截止日期之前发布的模型添加标记支持。
- **检测**：Anthropic将帮助用户和第三方检测Claude标记，后续将提供详细文档。

标记的工作原理：

1. **嵌入文本水印**：Claude在生成的文本中嵌入不可见水印。这不会影响含义、质量或可读性，并且在复制、粘贴和某些编辑操作后仍然保留。
2. **签名来源元数据**：对于支持的文件类型（如.svg、.png、.jpg），Claude会附加符合C2PA标准的签名元数据，表明该文件经过Claude处理，并支持篡改检测。

局限性：

- 检测到标记表示内容可能经过Claude处理，但不确认完整的来源；Claude可能不是原始作者，内容之后也可能被修改。
- 没有标记并不证明内容不是AI生成的。标记可能因以下原因缺失：使用旧模型、大量编辑/改写、文本过短、元数据被剥离，或平台/功能不受支持。

Anthropic建议使用Claude构建应用的开发者独立评估自身在《第50条》下的义务，并表示将在获得技术指导后分享有关标记和检测的技术指南。

title: Stowaway – Take the window seat on any plane or satellite overhead
summary: Stowaway is a real-time web experience that lets you “ride along” with any aircraft or satellite currently passing overhead. Using your actual location and the live sky above you, it shows the genuine aircraft and satellites in view. You can click on one to follow its path, or “stow away” to take a virtual window seat aboard it, seeing real terrain below. The scene is rendered in real time using JavaScript and WebGL 2, so those must be enabled for the site to work.
chinese_title: 偷渡者——抢占头顶任何飞机或卫星的靠窗座位
chinese_summary: 偷渡者是一款实时网络体验，让你可以“随行”任何当前正从头顶飞过的飞机或卫星。它利用你的实际位置和你上方实时天空，显示视野内真实的飞机与卫星。你可以点击其中一个来追踪其路径，或者“偷渡”上去，仿佛坐在它的虚拟窗边座位，俯瞰下方真实的地形。场景使用JavaScript和WebGL 2实时渲染，因此必须启用这两项才能正常使用该网站。
